pages.text: Three $(l)world cores$(), worn in an alchemical accessory slot, made at the $(l)truth altar$() with their world's soul as the main material.$(br2)$(l)World souls$(): a Warden, Wither or Ender Dragon bearing 7 or more affixes (its sin affix counted) always drops its soul when a player fells it.$(br2)$(l)Recipes$(): never in chests or the spirit realm. A sage who fells one of these bosses has the epiphany of its core.$(br2)Wearing one needs 50 luck; each core is stronger in its own world.
$(l)Overworld Soul$(): dropped by a Warden with 7+ affixes.$(br2)Max health +20%, armor +4, toughness +4, constant Haste II.$(br)$(l)In the Overworld$(): heal 2% of max health every 2s.

$(l)Nether Soul$(): dropped by a Wither with 7+ affixes.$(br2)Attack damage +15%, permanent fire resistance; melee hits ignite for 5s, +25% damage to burning targets.$(br)$(l)In the Nether$(): that bonus rises to +50%.

$(l)End Soul$(): dropped by a Ender Dragon with 7+ affixes.$(br2)Speed +10%, reach +2, no fall damage; 15% chance to dodge a hit and blink nearby (3s cooldown).$(br)$(l)In the End$(): dodge chance rises to 30%.

$(l)World Core$(): the three souls and three cores, at the primordial altar; 80 luck; its recipe is carried by a Sin Lord.$(br2)Max health +30%, armor and toughness +6, attack +25%, speed +15%, reach +3; Haste II, fire resistance, no fall damage, heal 3% every 2s; ignites, +50% vs. burning, 30% dodge. Realm cores count as at home anywhere.
End core dodge adds to armor and accessory Void in a single roll, with no combined cap. While wearing the core, all sources share its 3s cooldown. Fall immunity remains independent.
